pictures.name: QN1-Ten-Coins
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Inside a small stone village house with one tiny window, afternoon. a village woman in her thirties with a warm round face, dark hair under a terracotta-red head covering and a simple blue dress, sits on a mat counting small silver coins laid out on a woven cloth, nine in a row and an empty space, her hand frozen, face suddenly worried. Dim light, deep shadows.
